java_locations.role: Removes the opener before passing the body block's LineLocation to reallyCreateLeaf.
Uses the same first-body-record provenance for attached multiline notes.

rust_locations.role: Stores the opener's current_line and never replaces it with the source-mapped first body record.
Provides source-mapped line records, so arithmetic opener+1 would be incorrect across preprocessing markers.

claimed_invariant: A nonempty Component multiline note, named or attached, records the source-mapped line of its first body record, including an initially blank record, rather than the opener. Inline notes retain their command line. The provenance then drives SVG data-source-line and any source-ordered UID or emission decisions.
causal_divergence: Rust initializes note_source_line from the opener and only accumulates body text afterward. Java removes the opener first and creates from the remaining block location. The mismatch is direct provenance loss, not a one-line geometric offset.
planned_model_change: Initialize multiline note provenance as unset and capture current_line from the first body record encountered through source_line_and_trimmed, before empty-line normalization. Use that captured line when materializing the note; do not compute opener plus one. Leave inline-note provenance unchanged.
perturbation_axes: first body record nonempty versus blank
note before versus after ordinary leaves
acceptance: Java and Rust data-source-line agree for fresh named and attached multiline notes.
Blank first body records and source markers use their actual mapped line rather than arithmetic.
Inline notes keep their command source line.
An independent checker attacks provenance discontinuities and source-ordered UID behavior.
forbidden_approaches: adding one to the opener line
keying on note text or fixture paths
changing comparator, baseline or source markers
